**Performance: pass-with-notes** at `5963c27c9957bfd97cdaf84092493a44dd6fdbb1`.

Reviewed `e0004f8..5963c27`: fix e06b5438 plus main merge/renumber. The prior atomic-close, owned drain/notice and cost qualifications stand.

An authorized owed-notice retry still makes **one owned notification task/FYI attempt**, followed by the keyed notice-told transaction on admission. It reconstructs sender-independent content from the closed row's original closer, close_bound and reason; the trigger's actor/why no longer shapes the message. No new audit-history read, timer, sweep or per-tick retry. Told/quiet repeats start no new notification.

close_bound is one metadata column copied/read in the existing close transaction/query, not another write or table-rebuild loop. Notifications now use constant **pij-bg**, and requester-triggered retry can complete its legitimate FYI rather than hit a self-send refusal. It remains a held FYI, not a new model wake. Stable IDs suppress duplicate messages; they do not cap overlapping retry tasks or eliminate full closed-body cloning and existing SQL/permission work.

The release-line change is string rendering of an existing failure receipt; it adds no lookup/rename/launch. No new recurring cost or executable site. Herring owns the full C32 identity grade; this pass confirms the replay's cost shape, not a replacement security verdict.

Migration **0040** replaces the still-unmerged 0037 and compiles schema 40 above main 39. #156 also proposes 0040: the second merger must renumber under the existing merge-order rule.

**CI:** CLEAN at this exact head. [CI 42390381816](https://github.com/AI-Substrate/pij-fleet/actions/runs/42390381816) succeeds in all four jobs; JUnit records **2,122 executed cases, zero failures/errors**, five Rust skips separately. The delivered-close regression checks original intent/binding/reason, asserted-holder trigger, requester trigger, daemon sender and no repeat; release rendering, cancelled-drain and all six spawn guards execute. Latest delivers **42390382534** passes; **42390381807** was cancelled.

No local build, test, runtime/race probe, model call or worktree edit. Prior live CPU/RSS/launch and contended close/drain/notice latency/retention readings remain owed.
